description: Render a visitor-facing preview of a landing page without publishing it. Unlike get_landing_page, which returns builder JSON, this returns previewUrl: a signed, unlisted URL that shows the page with the same layout, theme, form, and #form button anchors visitors will see. Drafts keep publicUrl and appPublicUrl null until publish_landing_page; open previewUrl to check copy and layout on a draft instead of putting unreviewed content on the public domain. The preview is not indexed. Signup forms on a draft preview do not collect contacts. This is read-only and never publishes, unpublishes, or changes the page.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: render_landing_page

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `render_landing_page` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

previewUrl.description: Signed, unlisted visitor-facing preview of the current page content. Works for drafts. Not indexed. Share this URL to review layout and copy without publishing.

publicUrl.description: Public visitor URL, or null until the page is published.

published.description: Whether the page is live on publicUrl. False for drafts.

status.description: draft or published. Drafts are only visible at previewUrl.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

title.description: Visitor-facing title from SEO metadata or the first heading.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.
